Name: Suffolk Sheep Recolor
Author: The13thBlackCat
Description: I was never very happy with the vanilla all-white sheep, so I threw together this quick little edit to give them black faces and legs like suffolk sheep. I also tweaked their sheared sprite a tiny bit so they look more like they've actually been sheared, and aren't just "less fluffy". I don't have a screenshot of the lambs handy right now, but they match the adults except for being a few shades darker (as suffolk lambs sometimes are), so all your sheep will match!
